headline: Six Fronts Surge as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: On day 455 the war remains a grinding stalemate but the intensity has sharpened across a half‑dozen corridors since the last edition three hours ago. Weathered Expanse still leads the butcher’s bill with 11,562 Colonial and 16,314 Warden dead in the past 24 hours and 40 ownership changes, the most recent only minutes old. Stlican Shelf follows with 3,681 Colonial and 4,513 Warden losses and 22 base swaps. Callahans Passage records 9,218 Colonial and 10,112 Warden casualties amid 17 exchanges, while Stonecradle adds 5,728 Colonial and 8,189 Warden dead with 19 flips. Nevish Line shows 5,140 Colonial and 4,551 Warden losses over 16 changes, and Linn Mercy has risen to 2,055 Colonial and 5,670 Warden dead with seven movements. Hourly casualty trends are accelerating on most of these fronts, and fresh enlistments are climbing sharply, signalling sustained manpower commitment. The remaining sectors stay largely static, held wholly by one faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity.
